name: Phase 92 Manual UI and Accessibility Evidence

journeys.title: Persistent Desktop Side Drawer Navigation
steps: User clicks header sparkle button (id='global-assistant-btn')
Side drawer slides in smoothly from right (width min(440px, 100vw)) with backdrop
Active page route and editor form retain state without losing unsaved changes
User presses Escape or clicks close button (✕); drawer closes and focus returns to trigger
journeys.notes: Complementary region labeled 'Daynori Assistant'; Escape key dismiss verified.

journeys.title: Streaming Text and Markdown Sanitization Rendering
steps: User enters question in textarea and clicks 'Ask'
Server streams Server-Sent Events (start, context, chunks, done)
Progressive text rendering displays live tokens as they arrive
Sanitizer strips any embedded HTML tags, javascript: links, and tracking images
Final state updates with authoritative citation markers and token settlement stats
journeys.notes: Tested with hostile HTML and tracking pixel payloads; all rendered safely as plain text/neutralized spans.

journeys.title: Knowledge Source Checkbox Controls and Starter Suggestions
steps: User selects/unchecks 'Help & Guides', 'Notes', 'Tasks', 'Journal'
User clicks a starter pill (e.g. 'Restore from Trash')
Textarea is populated and query runs automatically
Citations reflect only authorized opted-in source kinds
journeys.notes: Help-only queries return canonical deep links to /help?article=... without leaking personal notes.

journeys.title: Android Assistant Sheet with Keyboard Safety and History Deletion
steps: AssistantSheet mounts inside modal / bottom sheet with ScrollView and keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'
Question input retains focus while keyboard is active
User can cancel in-flight ask with 'Cancel ask' button
Recent turns list displays prior turns with 'Clear all' and individual '✕' delete buttons
Deleting turn purges database record and refreshes list
journeys.notes: Keyboard-safe layout verified; delete turn and clear all verified against API endpoints.

journeys.title: Citation Deep Link Navigation
steps: Answer references authorized source citation
User clicks citation link
Client verifies source access via POST /v1/ai/assistant/source-access
Router navigates to canonical route: /library?noteId=..., /plan?targetId=..., /journal?entryId=..., or /help?article=...
journeys.notes: Canonical routes prevent 404s; nonexistent/vault items display helpful feedback.
